To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the large deviations performance (i.e., exponential decay rate of error probability) of consensus+innovation distributed detector is characterized by the critical noise power, which is the ratio of the communication noise power to the signal-to-noise ratio of the local observations, and that this critical noise power depends on the network topology and the time-vary weight sequence used in the consensus step.

(i) under noisy communication, the distributed detector performance can be characterized using large deviations theory; (ii) a communication payoff threshold exists for distributed detection; (iii) the time-vary weight sequence {α(k) = b0/(b + k)} is a key design parameter for distributed detection over noisy communication networks.

the distributed detection performance over noisy networks can be characterized using a large deviations analysis and that the distributed detector performance can be improved by carefully designing the time-vary weights by which agents weigh the messages of their neighbors, which in turn depends on the network parameters and the communication noise power.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a large deviations analysis of consensus+innovation distributed detection over noisy communication networks.
the problem of detecting a target in the presence of noise.
the design and analysis of a class of distributed algorithms for detection and estimation over noisy networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the consensus+innovation distributed detector is a powerful tool for distributed detection over noisy network, but its performance is subject to the communication noise power.

the proposed distributed detection algorithm can achieve the same large deviations performance as a single agent, even in the presence of communication errors, as long as the communication error rate is not too high.
the consensus+innovation distributed detector can achieve a reliable decision at the cost of a communication noise power that is not necessarily smaller than the noise power in the observations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the consensus+innovation distributed detector can achieve an exponential error performance, and it is robust to the communication noises, but it requires a large amount of communication power.

the proposed consensus+innovation distributed detection algorithm can achieve a reliable distributed detection with a large number of measurements, even when certain agents cannot detect the target in isolation.

we have developed a distributed detection scheme that can be applied to any network topology and any number of agents, where agents exchange messages with their immediate neighbors, and we have shown that this simple scheme can achieve an exponential rate of detection performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in noisy networks, the distributed detector performance can be improved significantly by carefully designing the time-vary weights with which agents combine their local observations with their neighbors' messages.
, in the large deviation regime, distributed detection over noisy network is still reliable and efficient.
noisy networks can be harnessed to improve distributed detection performance, and that a proper design of the time varying weight sequence can achieve the best possible performance.
